title: Tech Note: Mailing Feature: Sending and Archiving Emails with ORDA
author: Marouane Ait Salah, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Morocco

historical_commentary.text: The native Transporter-based SMTP commands and ORDA entity storage shown here remain 4D's current, fully supported approach to email sending in 2026 — nothing about this pattern has been superseded.
related_updates: The old 4DIC (4D Internet Commands) plugin mentioned as legacy is now essentially unused; native Transporter commands (SMTP/IMAP/POP3 New transporter) are the standard

Later 4D versions expanded OAuth2 support directly into SMTP New transporter parameters (see also TN 21-11), reducing the need for hand-rolled password-based Gmail auth shown in some of this note's examples
